changes.comment: BREAKING (implementers only): host helpers. New host packlet: openOrInitializeTaskRepository opens or initializes a repository at a root in the strongest mode the root qualifies for, with an explicit labelled in-memory fallback, and trustedKindAuthority is a fixed ITaskAuthorization for trusted host principals. probeTaskRepositoryRoot exports the mode probe the repository uses (atomicReplace required). FileTreeTaskRepository.openOrInitialize decides open-versus-initialize under exclusive ownership. The manifest records initializedMode; opening a process-crash repository as session needs allowSessionOverDurable. TaskBroker gains whenIdle (never takes the writer, injected schedule), a writeGuard option around every broker write, and resumePendingRegistration for external registrations; IBoundTaskWriter gains resumePendingRegistration, IBoundTaskDelivery gains issued(), and ITaskRepository gains pendingRegistration.
